TONAWANDA, NY — ICE Buffalo officers arrested Saim Irgi, an illegal alien from Turkey who violently resisted our officers’ efforts to apprehend him.  

During the arrest, Irgi grabbed an officer’s taser but was not able to gain control of it — or the situation. Another officer deployed their taser to subdue him. The illegal alien was subsequently placed in restraints, taken into custody, and transported to Buffalo Federal Detention Facility. 

He was targeted for arrest due to his violent criminal history, which includes charges for: 
• Multiple assaults 
• Strangulation  
• Reckless endangerment
